name: Issue Split View
summary: Issues grouped by state with counts on the left, and the selected issue's description and properties on the right, collapsing to list-then-detail on phones.
useWhen: An issue tracker where people scan a grouped backlog and open one issue at a time to read or change its fields
A master-detail screen for tickets on a phone, where the list comes first and each issue opens with a Back button
avoidWhen: Moving work between columns by dragging, where planning/kanban-01 fits better
A single record with activity and comments and no grouping, where workspace/record-detail-03 fits better
